archetypes.name: dyn-closure-scan
archetypes.rationale: Skill closure scanner behavior and baseline banking are the main risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the /design Step 0a wording changes against the closure scanner rules. Verify the two shared references are no longer eager or conditional while the setup KV parsing and degraded-tools branch behavior remain explicit. Check that the design baseline values and regression test match the live scan rather than banking unrelated changes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
